hints: Rearrange the formula to make G the subject before substituting units.
Recall that force in base units is kg m s^-2.
teacher_walkthrough: Rearrange for G: G = F * r^2 / (m1 * m2).
Substitute base units: [F] = kg m s^-2, [r^2] = m^2, [m1 * m2] = kg^2.
Combine powers: kg^(1 - 2) * m^(1 + 2) * s^-2 = kg^-1 m^3 s^-2.
distractor_explanations: Correct. Rearranging gives [G] = [F][r^2] / [m^2] = (kg m s^-2)(m^2) / kg^2 = kg^-1 m^3 s^-2.
Incorrect mass power; mass appears in the denominator squared against one mass in the numerator.
Incorrect powers of length and time.
kg m^-1 s^-2 is the base unit of pressure (Pa), not gravitational constant.
